# Salim Silver

> Salim Silver creates handcrafted Javanese silver jewelry in Kotagede, Yogyakarta, and offers an in-person silversmith workshop.

Use these canonical pages to learn about the jewelry, workshop, heritage, store, and educational resources published by Salim Silver.

## Jewelry

- [Jewelry Catalog](https://salimsilver.com/catalog): Browse handcrafted silver jewelry.
- [Collections](https://salimsilver.com/collections): Explore jewelry grouped by collection.

## Visit and Learn

- [Silversmith Workshop](https://salimsilver.com/workshop): Learn about the hands-on jewelry-making experience in Kotagede.
- [About Salim Silver](https://salimsilver.com/about): Read about the family, artisans, and Javanese silversmithing heritage.
- [Store Location](https://salimsilver.com/store-location): Find the Kotagede store and visitor information.
- [Contact](https://salimsilver.com/contact): Ask about jewelry, custom designs, wholesale, or workshop visits.

## Resources

- [Blog](https://salimsilver.com/blog): Read stories about silver craftsmanship, jewelry, and Kotagede culture.
- [Silver Price](https://salimsilver.com/silver-price): View the latest silver price reference in Indonesian rupiah.
- [Gold Price](https://salimsilver.com/gold-price): View the latest gold price reference in Indonesian rupiah.

## Languages

- [Bahasa Indonesia](https://salimsilver.com/id): Visit the Indonesian-language site.
- [Nederlands](https://salimsilver.com/nl): Visit the Dutch-language site.
